acceptance_criteria: Pilot covers supported positives, soundness/protected-boundary negatives, incompatible changes and workflow failures.
Human reviewers assess normative meaning and diagnostic usefulness separately from machine proof validity.
Audit that each layer retained predecessor guarantees and closed its promised obligations.
State supported profiles, proof boundaries, owner decisions and remaining limitations; record a human use recommendation.

recommended_status_strategy: Append-only checked gate receipts/overlay bound to frozen original plan, with an explicitly recognized current-state reader. No silent change to frozen provenance report.

tasks.title: Formalize gate scope and evidence contracts
exit_criteria: Formal proofs of binding completeness, scope separation, accepted-feedback premises and R06-before-G4; definitions precede runtime.

tasks.title: Audit current evidence and metadata impact
exit_criteria: All required sources current or explicitly historical; original pilot coverage complete; mutable status impact enumerated.

tasks.title: Implement strict feedback and versioned gate status
exit_criteria: Mandatory exact review bindings and scope; validated receipt overlay/current reader; closed schemas; no frozen snapshot mutation.

tasks.title: Validate closure and fill actual pilot gaps
exit_criteria: Missing, substituted, stale, premature, interrupted and conflicting closure cases refuse; targeted proof reruns only for actual gaps.

tasks.title: Capture actual R06 assessment
exit_criteria: Actual direct assessment accepts original meanings and diagnostic usefulness against the exact original packet; revisions loop back.

tasks.title: Accept R06 with exact evidence
exit_criteria: All original R06 criteria evidenced; current reader resolves 34 of 35 accepted, G4 pending; prior sources unchanged.

tasks.title: Audit layers and prepare G4 recommendation
exit_criteria: Every L0-L4 promise mapped to scoped evidence and retained guarantees; current supported-use recommendation prepared.

tasks.title: Capture actual G4 use recommendation
exit_criteria: Actual recommendation addresses the final G4 audit and exact bounded use; silence and earlier unrelated feedback are insufficient.

tasks.title: Accept G4 and synchronize current view
exit_criteria: Accepted R06, current G4 artifacts and human recommendation; validated original task view resolves 35 of 35 accepted.

tasks.title: Final complete-plan/currentness audit
exit_criteria: 35 original tasks, 40 working units, 56 edges, all receipts/scopes/current views checked; successor 19 receipts and frozen closure retained.

tasks.title: Formalize shared semantic ownership and composition
exit_criteria: Independent target meanings and substitution/incomplete-evidence counterexamples; owner-source, import and eligibility contracts precede code.

tasks.title: E00 owned expression definitions
exit_criteria: Same root revision resolves one owned AST/hash; changed AST/revision invalidates evidence; three-valued/origin semantics retained.

tasks.title: E01 versioned evidence policies
exit_criteria: Exact evidence/issuer/revision/policy matching; all supports retained; opaque legacy token preserved; alternative policies separately proved.

tasks.title: E02 equivalent bounded traversal
exit_criteria: Equivalent complete simple-path universe; no partial absence; unknown/restriction behavior retained; sparse/dense costs measured.

tasks.title: E03 owned requirement universe
exit_criteria: Every exact owned criterion supported; subset/stale requirement/unsupported action evidence refuses; intent remains insufficient.

tasks.title: E04 composed lifecycle eligibility
exit_criteria: Transition implies complete current qualification and owner review; atomic recapture; public-path crash/recovery/concurrency; saved event refuses.

tasks.title: E05 transport refinement
exit_criteria: Typed domain import composes with byte/IR evidence; malformed bytes/type/Unicode cases; old input checks preserved; remaining assumptions named.

tasks.title: E06 larger independent theorem closures
exit_criteria: Substantial core/semantic closures with exact statements/definitions/universes/recursors/axioms; disagreement/refusal explicit; supported subset honestly reported.

tasks.title: Integrated successor pilot
exit_criteria: Actual composed pipeline retains lineage, complete obligations, no manufactured roots/fulfillment, fresh/saved distinctions and measured envelope.

tasks.title: Successor assessment and bounded-use decision
exit_criteria: Actual successor-scoped assessment; implemented assurance matches claims; optional I07 scope included only with exact closure coverage.
